task: Resume STEP-02 only to repair confirmed visible BioFabric BIF grammar/data-loss defects in the existing I/O lane work. Retain valid existing I/O and session-state work and edit only crates/core/src/io/** (ordinarily xml.rs and its owned source-module tests). Do not edit public types/signatures, Cargo manifests/lockfile, model/layout/alignment/CLI source, protected tests, fixtures, goldens, workflow files, or unrelated I/O behavior. Do not use Docker, Git add/commit, a verifier, benchmark/results paths, or operator-only runtime paths. ROOT's direct visible-fixture review found that current xml.rs parses/writes only <annotation name=...>, whereas BIF inputs/goldens use <annot tag="..." start=... end=... layer=... [color=...] /> inside nodeAnnotations, linkAnnotations, and shadowLinkAnnotations. Therefore standard annotations are lost, and optional-color annotations currently cannot be represented. Repair the reader to accept standard <annot tag> grammar (while preserving compatible support for its prior internal spelling if helpful), map tag to Annotation.name, and treat omitted color consistently with the fixed Annotation representation; write standard visible BIF <annot tag> grammar, omitting color when it is absent/empty. ROOT also confirmed NodeLayout has plain_drain_zones and shadow_drain_zones expressly for XML serialization, while visible BIF files contain per-node <drainZones>/<drainZone minCol/maxCol> and <drainZonesShadow>/<drainZoneShadow minCol/maxCol> (including self-closing empty containers). Current xml.rs drops all of this state. Parse and re-emit those zones in the owning node layout, preserving ordering and empty-versus-present semantics as far as the fixed Option<Vec<(usize, usize)>> representation allows. Do not change any visible fixture or golden; use compact owned source-module tests derived from this observed grammar to prove standard annotations (including absent color) and both drain-zone kinds round-trip. Retain the already repaired metadata, score-plugin, raw-network marker, display-option, layout-count, and raw plugin-data behavior unless a direct grammar conflict requires a compatible correction. Do not invent further alternate file-format contracts; use existing visible tags whenever the BIF grammar supplies one. Attempt the strongest non-Docker local checks available and record exact evidence/truthful uncertainty in RESULT.json; ROOT will run the authoritative bridge checks.
acceptance_criteria: Every edit remains confined to crates/core/src/io/** and any new tests are inside owned source modules; no fixed public API, manifest/lockfile, protected test, fixture, golden, or unrelated source changes occur.

Standard BIF <annot tag=...> records in each annotation section parse and write without loss of tag, ranges, layer, or optional color; legacy/internal spelling, if retained, cannot displace standard grammar on output.

Per-node plain and shadow drain-zone data from visible BIF grammar round-trips through NodeLayout, including multiple zones and empty containers within the fixed Option<Vec<(usize, usize)>> representation.

Previously repaired metadata, alignment score/plugin-data, raw-network-vs-layout, layout count, display option, network, and ordering behaviors remain protected by focused tests or existing code paths.
RESULT.json truthfully lists changed paths, tests actually run, remaining uncertainty, and blockers.
deliverables: A focused visible-BIF grammar/data-preservation repair under crates/core/src/io/**.
Narrow owned source-module tests for annotations and drain-zone session round trips.
A truthful RESULT.json in the lane worktree.
reason_for_acceptance_and_deliverables: The current XML reader/writer compiles but demonstrably loses visible BIF session layout data. The existing I/O owner can correct this bounded grammar issue without reopening independent model, layout, alignment, or CLI work.
